'''Alice Telesu''' (Japanese: '''テレス・アリス''' ''Alice Telesu'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP260|A Crowning Achievement]]''.

Alice was traveling with [[Professor Telesu|her archaeologist father]], who was studying hieroglyphics near a lake full of {{p|Slowpoke}} that suffered a drought after an earthquake.  According to the hieroglyphics, a Slowpoke needed to evolve into a {{p|Slowking}} to save the colony, but the {{p|Shellder}} in the lake kept on latching on to the Slowpoke and causing them to evolve into {{p|Slowbro}}. Alice's Slowpoke, Arthur, was able to make it, and was intelligent enough to lead the Slowpoke and Slowbro into an underground cave where water was plentiful.

Alice was saddened to see Arthur, who she had known since he was a baby, go. Nevertheless, she knew that it was for the best that he leave.

|desc=Alice had a {{p|Slowking}}, nicknamed '''Arthur''' (Japanese: '''アーサー''' ''Arthur''), which she had ever since he was a Slowpoke. A legend stated that a Slowpoke needed to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a Slowking to save the colony from a drought, but the problem was that all the {{p|Shellder}} in the lake kept evolving them into {{p|Slowbro}}. Arthur first appeared beside Alice and was introduced to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}.

The group watched as Arthur jumped across several rocks in an attempt to reach the [[King's Rock]]. As the Shellder tried to attack him, Arthur dodged them, but also slipped into the water. Using his tail as a propeller, Arthur was able to climb out of the water. As he reached the King's Rock, several Shellder jumped and tried to bite him, but {{AP|Larvitar}} used {{m|Screech}} and scared them off. Arthur was able to grab the King's Rock, and a Shellder clamped down on it, allowing him to evolve into Slowking.

After battling {{TRT}}, Arthur led the Slowpoke and Slowbro through a waterfall into the Slowpoke Paradise. Alice realized she needed to release Arthur so he could stay with the colony. Although she was sad, she knew it was the right thing to do.

He reappeared in ''[[EP263|Address Unown!]]'' where he was part of an {{p|Unown}}'s dimension.

Arthur's only known move is {{m|Confusion}}.}}
